name: Shiva Special Architecture (left amygdala + right hippocampus, 60 min)
origin: Todd Murphy, Shiva software (new in Shiva; Murphy: not tested in laboratory experiments)
summary: Shiva's 'Special Architecture' session: the amygdala signal on the left half of the ring and the hippocampal signal on the right half at the same time, both stepping back-to-front. Murphy states it may 'facilitate experiences commonly called religious or mystic' when used for 60 minutes in sensory deprivation, and that it has not been tested in laboratory experiments.
setting: 60 min in darkness and silence (sensory deprivation), eyes closed, relaxed without meditating or falling asleep.
schedule: Shiva's rule for 60-min sessions: once a week or once every two weeks, with no other sessions in between; never longer than 60 min.
notes: The four left coils (Fp1, FT7, TP7, O1) carry the amygdala signal stepping O1 → TP7 → FT7 → Fp1 (clockwise seen from above) and the four right coils (O2, TP8, FT8, Fp2) the hippocampal signal stepping O2 → TP8 → FT8 → Fp2 (counter-clockwise), 10, 12 … 20 ms per coil (Murphy's lecture example), so both run back-to-front. Murphy's page: 'the hippocampal signal, applied over the right runs counterclockwise, but the amygdala signal, applied over the left hemisphere, is applied in the opposite direction', so that 'both run back to front'. Both sides start at the back coils (O1, O2) and step forward in mirror image (the placement order is the counter-clockwise ring started at O1 only to set those start coils; how Shiva aligns the two sides is unpublished). Murphy says this is the only Shiva session that works this way. He pairs the hippocampus ('with its cognitive functions, and positive effects from the right side') with the amygdala ('an emotional structure with positive effects from the left, and negative ones from the right'), each chosen 'for its positive effects over that side', while each signal 'alters the binding factor' (vendor claim, extended from small Persinger-lab studies). One coil per site instead of Shiva's coil pairs. Both signal files are proprietary: the amygdala 'burstx' file is approximated by the built-in accelerating burst (6 → 30 Hz), 230 points × 3 ms (0.69 s, the published burst-firing length at the vendor's standard 3-ms points); the hippocampal 'LTP' file by a train of 4 theta bursts, each of 4 biphasic pulses 9 ms apart (after the 4-pulse 100 Hz bursts of Larson & Lynch), repeated every 186 ms (5.4 Hz, the spectral peak the vendor reports for its LTP signal), at 3-ms points; these are the same stand-ins as in the Shiva amygdala and hippocampus simple sessions. The two start together every 4.69 s, each followed by about 4 s of silence. The 10-20 ms ramp is Murphy's illustrative lecture example (six values over four coils per side here, so the ramp does not line up with one lap of a side): his other statements of the Shiva speed ('around 9 times per second', about 14 ms per coil on the full 8-coil ring by our arithmetic; in 2007 'around the same speed' as the 25-ms binding factor) do not agree with it, and the real Shiva timing tables are unpublished. Shiva lists 20, 30 and 60-min versions; this file runs the 60 min Murphy names for in-session effects; for shorter sessions before practice see murphy-shiva-special-architecture-30. Independent double-blind tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012). Left-handed or ambidextrous users should start with short sessions and stop on fear, irritability, sadness or anxiety; not for people with epilepsy; stop at once if distressed. Murphy asks users to report unpleasant sessions. He reports headaches in about 2% of users of an earlier version of the technology, mostly with hippocampal signals, and advises lowering the intensity by a third. Re-checked Oct 2026 against the vendor page: the directions, the back-to-front stepping, the 20/30/60-min options and the 'not tested in laboratory experiments' statement are confirmed; the page's direction quote and the note on the conflicting speed statements were added, the hippocampus/amygdala rationale is now quoted in the page's own words, the schedule follows the session-length page, and the program is unchanged.
